goal: Leave the dungeon through the north door of the great hall.

cell.description: A cold stone cell. A heavy door is open to the north.

hallway.description: A long hallway with torches on the walls.

kitchen.description: An old kitchen that smells of onions. Stairs go down.

cellar.description: A wet cellar full of empty barrels.

library.description: Tall shelves full of dusty books.

great_hall.description: A huge hall. In the north wall there is a big door with a brass lock.

rules: Commands: look | go <direction> | take <item> | use <item> | inventory
In a dark room you cannot see or take items unless you carry the lamp.
The north door of the great hall is locked. 'use brass key' in the great hall unlocks it.
